name: Listing abuse screening
summary: Flag a marketplace listing that breaks any stated listing rule.

input.state: The listing rules followed by the listing's title, price, and description.

prohibited_item.instructions: The listing offers an item the rules prohibit.
prohibited_item.criteria: Answer yes only when the state supports it; otherwise no.

price_abuse.instructions: The listing's price is a stated-rule violation - fee evasion, bait pricing, or a scam pattern the rules name.
price_abuse.criteria: Answer yes only when the state supports it; otherwise no.

misrepresentation.instructions: The listing's claims misrepresent the item under the rules.
misrepresentation.criteria: Answer yes only when the state supports it; otherwise no.

outputs.shape: flag/clear per listing; the caller reads the three answers for the reason

cost.bound: one noul per stated rule category

uncertainty.abstain: a listing that fits no rule clearly answers clear; novel abuse is a rules-update problem, not a model stretch
uncertainty.refusal: a refused listing reports refused and goes to manual review

limits: Each rule is a separate judgment so the flag carries a reason - one merged 'abusive?' would not.
Detection is a screening prior, not an enforcement action; the caller's reviewer decides.

examples.api: POST /v1/systemone per item, or /v1/classify with items as inputs
examples.mcp: oak-mcp ask tool with the same envelope

evidence.label: unmeasured
evidence.note: Composition is verified over recorded answers by crates/gym/tests/recipes.rs; model-quality measurement runs through a gym suite and is pinned here only when it exists.
